M1.name: Lively
M1.useCases: Promo videos, light narration, general voiceover, casual announcements

M2.name: Deep
M2.description: Low, full-bodied male voice — calm, serious, commanding
M2.useCases: Corporate content, formal announcements, documentaries, official guidance

M3.name: Authoritative
M3.description: Polished, confident, with strong presentation gravitas
M3.useCases: Business pitches, executive talks, investor briefings, high-trust narration

M4.name: Friendly
M4.useCases: Education, friendly explainers, onboarding, youth-oriented narration

M5.name: Warm
M5.description: Warm and hushed — calm, soothing, natural storyteller
M5.useCases: Audiobooks, relaxation, bedtime stories, reflective narration

F2.name: Bright
F2.useCases: Kids content, energetic ads, upbeat narration

F4.name: Confident
F4.useCases: Business pitches, leadership content, motivational talks
